app.description: GrooveRift: a place for people who live music.

home.title: Home
home.lead: Today's Daily Drop and the first answers will be here. That part is still being built.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.noAccount: No account? GrooveRift works by invitation only.
signIn.returnTo: After sign-in we take you back to the page you opened.
signIn.resetDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.
signIn.verifiedDone: Your address is confirmed. You can sign in now.

secondStep.title: One more step
secondStep.leadTotp: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
secondStep.leadRecovery: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each works once.
secondStep.useRecovery: No access to the app? Use a recovery code

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.lead: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. It is valid for 24 hours.
checkEmail.notArrived: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder.

reset.sentAgain: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder.
reset.newHelp: At least 12 characters, an upper-case and a lower-case letter and a special character.
reset.revokeNote: After the change your other devices will be signed out.

linkInvalid.title: This link no longer works
linkInvalid.reset: Links for a new password are valid for 30 minutes and work once.
linkInvalid.verify: Confirmation links are valid for 24 hours. You can request a new one at sign-in.

authErrors.lockedReset: Too many failed sign-ins. Set a new password to continue.
authErrors.tooMany: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
authErrors.emailNotVerified: The address is not confirmed yet. We sent a new confirmation link.
authErrors.banned: This account is suspended. The statement of reasons was sent by email.
authErrors.compromised: This password has appeared in known data breaches, so attackers try it first. Choose a different one.
authErrors.policy: The password needs at least 12 characters, an upper-case and a lower-case letter and a special character.
authErrors.emailTaken: An account with this address already exists. Sign in or request a new password.
authErrors.linkInvalid: This link no longer works. Request a new one.
authErrors.badCode: The code is not right. Check and try again.
authErrors.freshSession: Sign in again for this action.
authErrors.inviteInvalid: This invitation can't be used. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
authErrors.accountExists: You already have an account with this address.

authErrors.dnaCount: Pick at least two genres or skip this step.
authErrors.timeZoneInvalid: We couldn't recognise the time zone. Try again.
authErrors.notOnboarding: This step is no longer available.
authErrors.inviteMember: That address already has an account.

security.title: Security
security.passwordLead: Change your password. You can sign out your other devices in the same step.
security.newHelp: At least 12 characters, an upper-case and a lower-case letter and a special character.
security.twoFactorOn: On. We ask for the app code at sign-in.
security.twoFactorOff: Off. We recommend turning it on.
security.twoFactorStaff: Required for editor, moderator and admin accounts.
security.scanLead: Scan the code with an authenticator app (for example Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator) or enter the key by hand.
security.enterCode: Enter the code from the app
security.codesLead: Keep them somewhere safe. Each works once and replaces the app code if you lose your phone.
security.sessionsLead: Where you are signed in. Sign out any device you do not recognise.
security.revokedAll: All other devices were signed out.
security.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app; the key for manual entry is below

account.title: Account
account.emailLead: You confirm the change from your current address, then from the new one.
account.sent: We sent a confirmation link to your current address.

admin.title: Admin
admin.lead: Staff tools. Every action is recorded.

members.title: Members
members.name: Name
members.cannotSelf: You cannot change your own role.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Read-only. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.twoFactor: Staff must have two-step verification on. Turn it on in the security settings.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.lead: One invitation per address, valid {days} days. The link goes out by email only; only that address can open the account.
invites.email: Email of the person you invite

landing.title: One question a day, for everyone.
landing.lead: Discover your Music DNA, talk about music and connect with people whose taste differs from yours.
landing.dropText: One question about music every day, for everyone.
landing.dnaText: A spiral of your taste, from the genres and artists you pick.
landing.peopleText: Conversations and connections with people of different taste.
landing.inviteText: <brand>GrooveRift</brand> is in a closed alpha: members invite people they know. There is no waitlist.
landing.haveInvite: Have an invite? Open the link in your invitation email.

legal.draftText: This text is not final. A legal review is under way and nobody receives an invitation until it is done.
legal.noticeLine: You can report illegal content without an account.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: The terms under which you use GrooveRift: who can join (adults, by invitation), what you may post and how an account is closed.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What data we process, why and for how long, where it is stored and how you can download or delete it.

guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.lead: How we treat each other, what is not allowed and what happens when someone breaks the rules.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.lead: For now we only use cookies needed for signing in, security and your language choice. A full list with durations comes with the legal review.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: Contact addresses for members and for the authorities are published before the first invitations.

notice.title: Report illegal content
notice.lead: Anyone can use this form, with or without an account. Members can also report content from inside the app.
notice.urgent: If someone is in immediate danger, call 112.

categories.hate: Illegal hate speech or incitement to violence

notice.urlHelp: The address of the answer, profile or page on GrooveRift. If there are several, add the others to the explanation.
notice.explanationHelp: Describe what exactly is wrong and, if you know, which law it breaks.
notice.contactHelp: We will tell you what we decided. The person you report does not see who sent the report.
notice.contactOptional: For reports of child sexual abuse, your name and email are optional.
notice.goodFaith: I believe in good faith that the information in this report is accurate and complete.
notice.doneText: A person on our team will review it. If we have your email, we will tell you the decision.

errors.summary: The report was not sent. Fix the marked fields.
errors.urlRequired: Enter the link to the content.
errors.urlInvalid: The link should start with https://, for example https://grooverift.com/@name.
errors.explanationRequired: Describe why the content is illegal.
errors.emailInvalid: Check the email, for example name@example.com.
errors.goodFaithRequired: Confirm that the information is accurate.
errors.generic: The report was not sent because of an error on our side. Try again in a minute.
errors.tooMany: Too many reports from this network in a short time. Try again in an hour.

alphaPage.title: About the alpha
alphaPage.lead: GrooveRift is in a closed technical alpha: an early, unfinished version for a small group of invited adults.
alphaPage.whatText: Only part of what GrooveRift is meant to become: the Daily Drop, a profile with Music DNA, following, and reporting and blocking. The rest comes in the beta.
alphaPage.limit1: No messages, posts or people suggestions yet. They come later.
alphaPage.limit2: Profile photos come later. Until then a profile shows an initial.
alphaPage.feedbackText: A feedback form will be in the app, under Help. A contact address is published before the first invitations.
alphaPage.dataText: Data is stored on servers in the EU. The privacy policy describes what we process and for how long.
alphaPage.afterText: We delete nothing without notice. Whether alpha accounts and answers carry over to the beta will be announced before the first invitations.

system.naText: The link may be wrong, or the content no longer exists.
system.errorText: The page did not load. It's not you.
system.offlineText: This page is not saved for offline use. Check your connection and try again.
system.pausedSafe: Your data is safe, and the rest of the app works.

invite.title: You're invited to GrooveRift
invite.lead: One question a day for everyone. Discover your Music DNA, talk about music and connect with people of different tastes.
invite.alphaNote: Closed alpha: some things are still missing and may change.
invite.pwa: <brand></brand> is a web app (PWA). iOS and Android versions may come later.
invite.install: Add the app to your home screen: it opens like an app, with reminders.
invite.badLead: Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
invite.signedSameLead: The invitation is for {email}, and you're already signed in with that address. Nothing to do.
invite.signedOtherTitle: The invitation is for someone new
invite.signedOtherLead: You're signed in as @{username}. To accept an invitation for another account, sign out first. The invitation stays valid.
invite.signedNote: The invitation isn't used up until you accept it.

age.title: Are you 18 or older?
age.lead: <brand></brand> is a community of adult music lovers. We don't ask for a date of birth, only your answer.

minor.title: GrooveRift is for adults only, for now
minor.lead: Thanks for the honest answer. We stored nothing, and the invitation is untouched.
minor.mistake: If that was a mistake, go back one step.

language.title: Choose your language
language.fine: You can change it any time in Settings.

account.title: Create your account
account.emailHelp: The invitation is bound to this address.
account.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters with an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter and a special character.
account.terms: By continuing you accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms>.
account.privacy: How we use data is in the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
account.mismatch: The invitation is for one address: {email}. The Google account you chose has another address. Open the account with a password for the invitation address, or with a Google account that uses it. Another address needs a new invitation.

username.title: What's your name?
username.displayNameHelp: How others see you. Up to three words, written as you like.
username.usernameHelp: 3 to 30 characters: lower-case letters, digits and underscores.

reading.title: Which languages do you like reading answers in?
reading.help: You see such answers more often in the "For you" order. Nothing is hidden.

visibility.title: Who can see your profile?
visibility.lead: Choose one. You can change it any time.
visibility.publicLine: All members see your profile, Music DNA and answer history. You appear in Discover and compatibility. Signed-out visitors see your name, avatar and bio.
visibility.privateLine: Only followers you approve see your profile, Music DNA and answer history. You don't appear in Discover. Signed-out visitors see nothing.
visibility.same: Either way, all members see your answers and comments, and only followers see your follower list.
visibility.fine: You can narrow Music DNA further in the next steps.

dna.lead: Pick {min} to {max} genres. They become your Music DNA.

dna.count: {count, plural, one {# genre} other {# genres}} of {max}.
dna.searchHint: There are over 2,000 more. Type a name, e.g. "heavy metal".
dna.noResults: No such genre. Try another name.
dna.searchFailed: Search isn't working right now. Try again.
dna.moreResults: These are the best known. Not yours? Keep typing.
dna.artistsSoon: You'll be able to add artists soon, in the Music DNA editor.

dnaAudience.title: Who sees your Music DNA?
dnaAudience.legend: Choose one. Signed-out visitors never see it.

everyone.title: All members
everyone.desc: Everyone signed in. Used for Discover and compatibility.

followers.title: Followers only
followers.desc: Only people who follow you see it.

me.title: Only me
me.desc: No one else, not even in compatibility.

how.title: How GrooveRift works
how.dropText: A new music question every day, the same for everyone. The reminder arrives at 12:00; you can change the time.
how.pollText: One question for everyone, every week. You see the results when you vote.
how.knowText: Twice a week we uncover the stories behind the music.
how.peopleText: Music DNA shows who shares your taste. No percentages.

reminder.title: Don't miss the Daily Drop
reminder.lead: The Daily Drop is the heart of the community. One notification a day, when the new question is out. Nothing else.
reminder.exampleQ: Which song always takes you back to a summer?
reminder.note: One question a day and the whole Rift community in one place. The reminder gets you there in time.
reminder.installText: Add it to your home screen and it opens like an app. On iPhone, reminders work only then.

done.title: Ready.
